data.name: Priyabrata
data.gender_notes: Priyabrata is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Priya means beloved and Brata means of the gods. The name Priyabrata signifies someone who is beloved by the gods. The name Priyabrata carries the meaning “Beloved of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Priyabrata usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Priyabrata represents a deep connection with the divine. It is a name that signifies the grace and blessings of the gods.
data.etymology: Priyabrata belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beloved of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Priyabrata total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
